summary: The measured host loop repeats GOMP_parallel by the requested iteration count. Exact worker computes its assigned rows, processes every CSR nonzero per row, accumulates indexed value/vector products and stores row outputs including empty rows.

source_evidence.claim: Complete source contains runtime work/count, CSR initialization and timed repeated row computation.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clocked count-controlled GOMP calls and full exact worker row/nonzero loops, arithmetic and stores.
